effects.does: Clicking Ask Clara opens the Clara assistant.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara assistant appears.

effects.does: Clicking Export starts an export of the events shown in the history view.
effects.affects: Creates an export from the currently displayed event records without changing the events.
effects.leadsTo: Download or export result while staying on this screen
effects.check: Click Export and verify that an export is generated or downloaded.

effects.does: Clicking Create Event M opens the event-creation screen.
effects.affects: Starts the event-creation flow without publishing an event.
effects.check: Click Create Event M and verify that the create-event screen opens.

effects.does: Clicking Live 8583 switches the list to live events.
effects.affects: Changes the displayed event stage from history to live events.
effects.check: Click Live 8583 and verify that live events are displayed and the Live tab is selected.

effects.does: Clicking History 2035 keeps the history list selected.
effects.affects: Selects the history event stage and displays historical events.
effects.check: Verify that History remains selected and historical events are displayed.

effects.does: Clicking Drafts 183 switches the list to draft events.
effects.affects: Changes the displayed event stage to drafts.
effects.check: Click Drafts 183 and verify that draft events are displayed and the Drafts tab is selected.

effects.does: Clicking Recurring opens the recurring-events view.
effects.affects: Changes the displayed event collection from history to recurring events.
effects.check: Click Recurring and verify that the recurring-events view opens.

effects.does: Entering text in Search Title filters the history list by event title.
effects.affects: Changes which history event records are displayed without modifying their data.
effects.check: Enter a title fragment and verify that only matching history events remain visible.

effects.does: The disabled Starting from field cannot be filled or activated.
effects.affects: Nothing because the date filter is disabled.
effects.check: Attempt to click or type in Starting from and verify that its value does not change.

effects.does: The disabled Ending at field cannot be filled or activated.
effects.affects: Nothing because the date filter is disabled.
effects.check: Attempt to click or type in Ending at and verify that its value does not change.

cases.title: Open Ask Clara from event history
cases.expected: An Ask Clara assistant panel or screen opens without leaving the events area.
gaps: The exact Ask Clara assistant panel or screen opening state is not defined by a domain assertion step.
The specific event-row context in which Ask Clara is available is not expressible without a known event title or project id.

cases.title: Open the event export flow
cases.expected: An export dialog, menu, or download flow opens for the historical events.
cases.setup: Load /orders with History 2035 selected and at least one historical event visible.
gaps: An export menu opening instead of a dialog
A file download being initiated or completed

cases.title: Switch between event status tabs
cases.expected: Each clicked tab becomes selected and displays its corresponding event view. "History 2035" is selected at the end.
gaps: Direct assertion that each clicked tab has selected state styling
Verification of the numeric tab counts: Live 8583, Drafts 183, and History 2035

cases.title: Search history with no matching title
steps: Enter a unique string that is not the title of any historical event in "Search Title".
cases.expected: The history list shows no matching events and displays the screen's empty-results state.

cases.title: Verify date fields are unavailable on history
cases.expected: "Starting from" and "Ending at" remain disabled, do not accept focus or input, and do not change the event list.
gaps: Prove that the event list contents remain exactly unchanged after the attempted date interactions.
